mode: Keep the InnoDB, native name and lexical profile and the same external source declaration. The checked text role uses the stock utf8mb4_bin collation.
structure: One physical checked table source, with a projecting TextColumnReference owning its native Varchar slot. Existing source-free and signed cases remain unchanged. A text field may be used with IS NULL or IS NOT NULL.
conditions: For any projection containing a text reference, bound the logical record by charging each selected VARCHAR once per projected occurrence. Charge four bytes per declared character plus one length byte for a maximum body of at most 255 bytes and two otherwise. Reserve eight bytes for every other expression and one null bit per output. Reject a total above 65535 before publication. Column roles, heading and prior projection conditions remain enforced. The budget protects logical shape. Physical allocation and page configuration remain native environment conditions.
meaning: Copy the selected field's native VARCHAR length, charset, collation, default and nullability according to the same external declaration, with exact values, duplicate multiplicities and native write effects. Distinctness may choose any whole-row representative of one PAD SPACE equivalence class. Text ordering compares virtual U+0020 padded values under the fixed binary collation, and ties obey the source contract's peer group relation.
sql: Render each resolved VARCHAR operand as its checked physical reference, preserving its output name and occurrence. Emit the existing qualified projection, exact filter and row bounds.
observations: Compare inherited type, lengths 0 and 8, zero-length defaults, NULL and Unicode values, and repeated text fields.

Use differently valued schemas and lifetime overlays to detect incorrect binding. Preserve actual bytes in stored values. Compare row bags, positional selection, collation peers and allowed whole-row DISTINCT representatives.
Compare native transaction, existence and rollback effects with the previous independent model.
Measure the native 65535-byte logical layout and 65536-byte overflow using two repeated VARCHAR(8191) fields and either two or three VARCHAR(0) fields. The over-bound role fails before publication.

finite.completeness: Recover the source coordinate, lifetime, output shape, destination namespace, predicate and distinctness from the observed checked value. Compare each fixture identity once.
